div.head: I Cn 22.1
div.ab: Forðam mid þam oþrum sceal ælc Cristen mann hine to Gode gebiddan ⁊ mid þam oðrum geswutelian rihtne geleafan.
Forðam mid ðam oðrum [we ssculan us gebiddan ⁊ mid þam Credan] geswytelian rihtne gehleafan.
Forþan mid þam oðrum sceal ælc Cristen man hine to Gode gebiddan ⁊ mid þam oðrum geswutelian rihtne geleafan.
quia per illud Deum exoramus, per aliud rectam fidem declaramus.
[22, 1] quia per ‘Pater noster’ debet Deum orare et per ‘Credo (in Deum)’ fidem suam ostendere.
quoniam altera quidem cum domino Deo loquimur, altera uero rectam fidem indicamus.
Forðam mid ðam oðrum [sceal ælc Cristen mann hine to Gode gebiddan ⁊ mid þam oðrum] geswytelian rihtne gehleafan.
Forðam mid þam oþrum sceal ælc Cristen mann hine to Gode gebiddan and mid þam oðrum geswutelian rihtne geleafan.
Denn durch jenes erstere soll jeder Christenmensch zu Gott beten und durch dieses zweite den rechten Glauben darlegen.
For with the first every Christian man is to pray to God, and with the second declare the true faith.
For with the first every Christian man shall pray to God, and with the second declare the true belief.
For with the first of these, every Christian shall pray to God, and with the second testify to the true faith.
